title: jobs settings
description: Operator settings for the jobs module (company.yaml modules.jobs). Secrets (admin token, hash key, webhook secret, encryption keys) are never settings; can-core generates them as Secrets.

approval_required.description: A job needs an approved requisition before it can open.

x-can.risk: jobs open without an approved requisition

collect_eeo.description: Show the voluntary diversity questions on the apply form. Whether collecting them is lawful or required is the operator's decision (docs/recruiting.md).

x-can.risk: diversity data about applicants is collected

retention.description: Retention in days, counted from the last decision on a candidate's applications. Review against local law; the defaults are not advice.

talent_pool_days.description: Candidates who opted into the talent pool (default 730).

x-can.risk: talent pool candidates are deleted sooner
hired candidates' records are deleted sooner

closed_job_days.description: Closed jobs with no applications left are deleted this many days later (default 1095; 0 keeps them).

scanner_required.description: Refuse resume uploads while no virus scanner is wired in. Turn off only for development.

x-can.risk: resumes are accepted without a virus scan

apply_per_hour.description: Public applications per client address per hour (default 10).

x-can.risk: one address may apply more often

default_valid_days.description: How long a job is advertised as valid when it does not say (default 60).

consent_version.description: Version recorded with each candidate's consent; change it with consent_text.

consent_text.description: Text beside the consent checkbox of the application form.

eeo_min_cell.description: Diversity report cells with fewer answers than this are hidden (default 5).

x-can.risk: smaller groups of applicants can be told apart in diversity reports

idle_minutes.description: Web UI: sign out after this many minutes without activity (default 30).

x-can.risk: idle web sessions stay signed in longer

absolute_hours.description: Web UI: the longest a session lasts (default 8).
